instructions.title: Instructions for operating the sauna
instructions.details:
The sauna is controlled by two knobs placed on the stove.
 The left knob sets the time, please set it no longer than 4 hours (values on the white background from 0 to 4).
 The right knob sets the power. Please regulate the power so that it does not exceed 100°C. By default 2/3 of the power is sufficient in our saunas.
 After using the sauna, please set both knobs to zero.
 Our sauna is a Finnish sauna. The appropriate and healthy temperature for the body is max 100°C, humidity in the range of 40-60%.
 Please do not pour too much water on the stones (this is not a steam sauna). You can pour two tablespoons of water once every 10-15 minutes. Please pour carefully, do not pour on the stove.
